items.t: Procter & Gamble Wants $10 Billion in Savings and Fewer Factory Workers
items.sum: P&G just told investors its plants and trucks will run with far fewer people by 2030. The bigger question is whether those savings ever reach shareholders, or whether rising oil and freight costs swallow them first.

items.t: Procter & Gamble Plans up to 30% Supply Job Cuts by 2030, Aims for $10 Billion in Cost Savings
items.sum: Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) stock edged slightly higher during Friday’s premarket session after closing roughly 1.4% lower after the consumer goods giant’s investor day event held on Thursday. The company targets up to $10 billion in productivity savings between fiscal 2027 and 2030, building on savings of $2.8 billion in fiscal 2026.
